# Hash-pinned install for the bashate linter used by bash-checks.yml.
#
# pip's --require-hashes mode demands that every requirement, including
# transitive ones, is pinned with == and carries a hash. bashate's only
# dependency is pbr, so the full tree is two entries. Both wheel and sdist
# hashes are listed so pip can satisfy either.
#
# Renovate does not currently watch this file. See the Pinned-Dependencies
# notes in CONTRIBUTING.md before bumping by hand.

bashate==2.1.1 \
    --hash=sha256:3104d565a7a0f7ee2cf4028cc584c723a202f52a8ddffe4a39b8cbb0ac5d3e94 \
    --hash=sha256:4bab6e977f8305a720535f8f93f1fb42c521fcbc4a6c2b3d3d7671f42f221f4c

pbr==7.1.1 \
    --hash=sha256:8e36e7b36cd0d081cca95c7b50d5760b17d7dd7d58a86044186d916e8be1f09d \
    --hash=sha256:973da2aee9961d7cb278aa74e1829f6daafec9dd8ee8c1655cbf3f5843bfe083
